visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair tied in a bun with a white scrunchie is seated in a cafe. She wears a maroon off-the-shoulder ruffled top and white high-waisted trousers. She sits on a gray cushioned bench next to a small round table with a drink and a white designer handbag. (2) She looks into a small compact mirror, holding a makeup brush, then looks towards the camera with a playful smile, pointing to her face. (3) The scene cuts to a white studio background. The woman holds a pink 'Moody' brand pencil and demonstrates it by drawing a line on the back of her hand, showing a creamy, berry-toned texture. (4) Close-up shots show her applying the pencil to her lip peaks and corners, creating a 'V' shape and defining the edges. She uses a lip brush on the other end of the pencil to smudge the lines. (5) She then applies a white tube of lipstick or balm to the center of her lips. (6) The video concludes with a split-screen 'Before' and 'After' comparison of her lips, followed by her posing with the pink pencil against the white background while pink hearts float around.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM starts immediately with a strong synthesizer beat. A bright female voice greets 'Hey baby' with high arousal. (2) A male voice responds with a confused, low-pitched 'Uh... hair?'. (3) A bubble-pop SFX triggers as the female voice playfully offers 'two more chances' in a teasing tone. (4) The male voice guesses again, 'Eye makeup?', sounding uncertain. (5) Another cartoon-style 'boing' SFX sounds as the female voice says 'Last chance' with rising intonation. (6) The male voice correctly guesses 'Lips?' followed by a bright 'Ding' SFX. (7) The female voice transitions into a professional, energetic narration, describing 'Moody' products. A swoosh SFX marks the visual cut to the tutorial. (8) Detailed instructional narration follows, with the female voice explaining lip lining steps clearly, accompanied by consistent upbeat BGM. (9) The audio ends with a cheerful concluding phrase and a final swell of the electronic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Interaction -> Problem/Solution -> Step-by-step Tutorial -> Result -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional tutorial for Moody brand lip products. It uses a relatable social scenario (asking a partner if they notice a difference) as a hook to introduce the product. It then provides a clear, step-by-step guide on how to achieve a 'plump lip' look using the specific Moody lip liner and lipstick, aiming to drive consumer interest and sales.
